retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, gritty composition featuring a central metallic object suspended in a dark, textured void with weathered serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, weathered brass-like ring or collar with various antique keys hanging from chains, set against a heavily distressed black background with vertical light streaks at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Central metallic object as the primary focal point
High contrast between bright metallic highlights and deep black shadows
Vertical alignment of hanging keys creating downward visual weight
Textured, chipped paint effect unifying the foreground and background
coreInvariants: Heavily distressed and weathered surface textures
Muted metallic color palette (gold, silver, rust)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central subject occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, circular metallic collar at the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down movement from the large display text to the central object, then following the hanging keys downward to the subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black, textured negative space surrounding the central object to emphasize isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark charcoal background with heavy grain.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Aged gold and brass metallic highlights on the central object.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cool silver and oxidized grey on the hanging keys.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Visible weathering and 'chipped' texture within the glyphs
Custom swash or extension on specific characters to create flow
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' features an elongated leg that underlines subsequent letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a heavy, weathered Roman display face and a delicate, spaced-out Gothic subtitle.
graphicDevices: Vertical light streaks/stalactites at the top edge
Heavy film grain and dust overlays

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the flared serifs and classical weight
Provides the base Roman skeleton for the display text
Approximate style for the bottom calligraphic text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark, gritty background with heavy black textures and chipped paint effects. In the center, place a weathered brass collar with various antique keys hanging from chains. Add vertical white light streaks at the very top edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, weathered Roman serif title at the top center with a cracked paint texture. Add a small, widely-spaced Gothic subtitle at the bottom center in clean white.

verificationChecks: Is the central object metallic and weathered?
Is the background predominantly black with high-contrast texture?
Does the top text have a wide, distressed serif appearance?
Is the bottom text spaced out and calligraphic?

adjustableVariables: Number and style of hanging keys
Brightness of the top light streaks
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text weathering matches background distress
Verify the vertical balance of the keys
Confirm the background is sufficiently dark for contrast
recipe.reuseFormula: Central weathered relic + Distressed Roman display text + Gothic subtitle + High-contrast dark void.
